source: Live Supabase project nsbrupcpwgjnhsysvbes, queried 2026-10-26 (pg_enum order_status, order_transitions, pg_get_functiondef(_validate), simulation_orders run 4, stock_movements)
run4_harness_defect: In run 4 the wrong_product branch selected the substitute product with WHERE sku = (array[...])[1+floor(random()*6)], so random() was evaluated per row and sometimes matched no product. 13 of 35 wrong_product orders were therefore submitted with an empty line and blocked as 'Quantity must be a whole number'. Those 13 blocks are harness artefacts, not detections. Verified by: select seq, items, messages from simulation_orders where run_id=4 and planted_error='wrong_product' and outcome='fail' (items = [], message 'line - Quantity must be a whole number'). Fixed in run_simulation_final.
